title: fix(app-shell): Studio's rails mark a customization with a short word, no fill, instead of a filled plus that read as an add button

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuGDAtpB63x28wJ1Y26PFgRx)_

Fixes #30070

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 左栏里定制过的行，原来右侧是一个带底色的小方块图标（新增是绿底加号），现在改成一个彩色短词、没有底色：中文「定制」「新增」，英文「Custom」「Added」。鼠标悬停的提示和读屏名称不变，仍是完整说明（「已定制（CRM）」加定制包那句话）。
- 为什么改：绿底加号看起来像「添加」按钮，维护者点过一次没反应；裁决 6631229752 选 A：用文字、不要底色、保留提示、点击仍只是选中这一行。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个展示组件的紧凑分支和一个新词条（en/zh 各一行），不动数据和接口；英文比原来的 18px 图标宽约 22px（Custom 40px），行名会多截一点；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/CustomizationMark.tsx` 的 `if (compact)` 分支、`StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572.test.tsx` 的「the rail mark never takes the row’s name」用例、`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` 的 `engine.customizationMark.customizedShort`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572.test.tsx`，预期 27 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The compact mark.** `CustomizationMark`'s `compact` branch (every pillar rail row through `RailCustomizationMark`, and the Interfaces rail's navigation-override mark, which wraps it in its popover button) no longer draws an 18×18 filled block with a lucide glyph. It prints one short word in the kind's colour with no background: `customized` reads the new `engine.customizationMark.customizedShort` (定制 / Custom), `added` reads the existing `engine.customizationMark.added` (新增 / Added). Its `role="img"`, accessible name (the full label, e.g. 已定制（HotCRM）) and tooltip (that label, then the sentence naming the pair) are unchanged. It carries no handler: a click on it is a click on its row.
- **The non-compact chip** (All metadata lists) is unchanged.
- **i18n (the widening).** One new `studio` namespace row in en and zh: `engine.customizationMark.customizedShort`.
- **Comments.** `CustomizationMark.tsx` and `RailCustomizationMark` say the mark is a word, no fill, and not a control.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30070-customization-mark-words.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-p3zei2`, not `claude/issue-30070-*`; the card is #30070.

## Tests

`StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572.test.tsx`'s rail-mark case (it pinned `textContent ''`) now pins: the customized mark prints `engine.customizationMark.customizedShort`, the added mark prints `engine.customizationMark.added`, both keep the full label as accessible name and tooltip head, neither holds an `svg`, and neither carries a `bg-` class. Expectations are read from Studio's table, never retyped.

## Acceptance notes

- **The English word is `Custom`, not `Customized`.** The ruling names the zh words only. Measured on the example CRM's automations rail (row 223 px wide): 定制 and 新增 are 22 px each (the glyph was 18 px), `Added` is 34 px, `Customized` was 61 px and cut the selected row to "Convert Lea…", `Custom` is 40 px. The seat may prefer another word; it is one en row.
- `InterfacesNavRail.tsx` was not edited (PR #30401 holds it). Its `InterfacesNavOverrideMark` doc comment still says "the compact customized glyph"; the comment is now stale wording only, behaviour measured below. Left for whoever next touches that file.
- `KIND_CLASS` (the filled colours) now serves the non-compact chip only; `customizationOf` has no compact caller and would print its full label if one appeared.

## Verification

Gates and tests ran on `cabd8ba8`; the head adds an evidence commit and its removal, the tree is byte-identical (`git diff cabd8ba8 HEAD` is empty). Base `b6caa141`.
